name: Deprecation tracking
description: Track a deprecation, freeze, or removal of a PyTorch API or component

fields.label: Template instructions
fields.default: One issue per deprecated API or frozen component. After filing, attach this issue as a sub-issue of the umbrella [#201298](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/201298). Warning periods follow the [backward compatibility policy](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/wiki/PyTorch%27s-Python-Frontend-Backward-and-Forward-Compatibility-Policy). See [AI-Assisted Development](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/main/AI_POLICY.md) policy.
